corridor_notes: ~70km subsea pipeline (CNOOC's '涠北管线'/Weibei line) between Weizhou Island and Tieshan Port, Beihai. Sources state the pipe runs directly between the Weizhou terminal and the Tieshan Port landfall receiving station with no named intermediate onshore waypoints (subsea route). One routing detail: in Jan 2023 the line crossed beneath Beihai's planned 300,000-DWT shipping channel near Weizhou Island; to avoid impacting the channel the project team used sea-to-sea trenchless horizontal directional drilling (HDD), routing the pipe 18-22m below the seabed through the mud layer beneath the planned channel. Commissioned/gas-in 2023-04-11, 13 days ahead of schedule.
researcher_notes: Builds on the pilot digest's confirmed-existence finding (medium tier per standing rule 4: sasac.gov.cn/thepaper.cn/ndrc.gov.cn are one CNOOC/state-media announcement reprinted across three hosts, not editorially independent). This pass re-verified all three URLs live (all 200) and pulled the raw article text directly (curl, not AI-summarized) to confirm the precise start/end station language: start = '涠洲终端' (Weizhou terminal, on Weizhou Island, matched to a named OSM industrial feature '中海油涠洲终端'); end = an unnamed receiving station built specifically for this project at the 'Tieshan Port landfall point' ('铁山港登陆点'), fitted with pigging-receiver/filter/metering functions. No source found (including a re-check of the SASAC/thepaper/NDRC texts and a search for the prior pass's leads) gives the receiving station a proper name, a village/township-level location, or coordinates, so the end anchor is geocoded only to the Tieshan Port District (铁山港区) centroid, not a station-level fix. No GIS/vector layer found.
blockers: End-point precision is district-level only: no source names or precisely locates the Tieshan Port receiving station beyond 'Tieshan Port landfall point'. A human researcher with China-based network access could try the still-unreachable fgw.gxzf.gov.cn notice (t16217273.shtml) that the sheet cites for Diameter/Pressure/ProposalYear, which might carry a more specific siting description, but it has been unreachable (ConnectTimeout) across two independent research passes.
